verdict.rationale: incident.io ships genuine autonomous background automation: Workflows can auto-publish status updates and run actions on incident state changes (docs-9, docs-69), and the Investigations agent autonomously gathers evidence, forms hypotheses, and tests them across code/telemetry the moment an incident is declared, without a human prompting it (docs-14, docs-16, docs-23, docs-31, docs-56, docs-84, docs-90), with dedicated trust-and-safety controls for letting the AI agent act on live incidents (docs-17, docs-63). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that Workflows/Investigations run unattended at scale, and more detail on user-configurable automation triggers beyond status pages/investigations.
